text_en: My name is Linh, and I'm in Year 3.
My school day starts at half past seven.
I like maths, but sometimes I make mistakes.
At break time, I play in the playground with my classmates.
On Tuesdays, we have science in the laboratory.
My favourite subject is art because I love painting.
We eat lunch in the canteen at twelve o'clock.
In the afternoon, we work in groups on our projects.
This term, our project is about animals in danger.
